row.evidence: Zoho Directory documents SCIM Directory Stores for Okta, Entra ID and JumpCloud ("Plan required in Zoho Directory: Free plan"), and synced users can be assigned to Zoho CRM, but no Zoho CRM page names the CRM edition that includes it.
row.notes: New row. Provisioning works through Zoho Directory, the identity layer behind every Zoho CRM org: an IdP pushes users over SCIM into a Directory Store and they are assigned to CRM (manually or by conditional assignment). CRM's pricing and comparison pages list no SSO, SAML or SCIM line, and CRM's Zoho Directory help names no edition, so the CRM-side gate is undisclosed. Zoho Directory's Free plan is capped at 10 users while CRM help says there is no limit on CRM users synced to Directory. A Starter edition appears on the comparison page with INR pricing only (regional) and is not recorded. The CRM Users API (add, update, activate/deactivate, delete) is on every edition including Free.

scim.notes: SCIM lands in Zoho Directory (the org-wide identity layer every Zoho app uses) through a Directory Store; the "Sync endpoint" URL is generated per store and its pattern is not documented. Zoho's Okta guide pairs the SCIM app with a SAML app pointing at Zoho Directory Custom Authentication, but the Entra, JumpCloud and custom-store guides do not require SSO, so sso_required is left null. Zoho CRM's own pages describe Zoho Directory integration (SAML, security policies, Active Directory sync) but name no CRM edition for it and never mention SCIM.

auth.token_source: Zoho Directory Admin Panel > User Management > Directory Stores > Add Directory > (Okta / Entra ID / JumpCloud / Create Custom Store) > API INTEGRATION: Sync endpoint and SCIM token
auth.notes: Okta sends the token as an HTTP Header (Authorization). The Microsoft Entra gallery app "Zoho One" uses OAuth (Code Auth Grant) instead of a static token.

operations.notes: Okta can Push New Users and Push Profile Updates; user status changes are synced when Status Sync is enabled. Okta custom app integrations cannot Push Groups; JumpCloud syncs users through selected user groups. Update method (PUT vs PATCH) not documented.

deprovision.notes: Status changes in the IdP deactivate the Zoho Directory user when Status Sync is on. Deactivation releases a Zoho Directory licence; whether it frees the app seat is not documented.

filtering.notes: From Microsoft's Zoho One provisioning tutorial (userName marked as supported for filtering).

custom.how: Directory Store field mapping: profile field, hard-coded value, expression, custom attribute or JSON path mapped onto Zoho Directory fields (custom fields)

attributes.notes: Core and group attribute lists come from Microsoft's Zoho One provisioning tutorial (gallery app); Zoho Directory's own guides only describe field mapping in the admin panel.

roles.how: Zoho Directory conditional assignment assigns apps (and app roles, e.g. Zoho Desk roles/departments, Zoho CRM admin) based on group membership or designation; not a SCIM roles attribute

limitations.text: Okta custom app integrations cannot Push Groups or Import Groups.
JumpCloud syncs only groups of users, not individual users.
Entra provisioning runs on a 40-minute cycle (or on-demand Provision).
Zoho Directory Free plan allows only up to 10 users; paid Directory licences are $2 (Standard) or $7 (Professional) per user. How users of paid Zoho apps count against this is not documented.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit Logs are on every paid edition in the comparison table; an audit-log API was not checked.

rate_limits.text: API credits per org per day: 5,000 (Free), 100,000 (Standard), 500,000 (Professional), 1,000,000 (Enterprise), unlimited (Ultimate)

limitations.text: Adding users fails with LICENSE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED when the CRM plan's licences are used up.

okta.notes: The OIN "Zoho CRM" app is checked only for SWA (password vaulting). Separately, an OIN "Zoho One" app is SAML only, and Zoho documents a custom Okta SAML + SCIM app for Zoho Directory.

entra.notes: Gallery app is "Zoho One" (also a separate "Zoho" SSO app). Microsoft says to contact Zoho One support to enable provisioning. Zoho Directory also documents Entra ID SCIM provisioning via a Directory Store (sync endpoint + SCIM token).

jumpcloud.notes: Zoho's guide uses a JumpCloud Custom Application with Identity Management (SCIM base URL + token); no JumpCloud catalogue page was checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Active Directory sync via Zoho Directory Sync tool
